links.outcome: Change in sentiment and emotional tone after LLM simplification of patient education materials
links.effect: Simplification shifted sentiment toward more positivity (higher VADER compound scores, fewer neutral tokens); disgust decreased significantly, while sadness, surprise, and joy increased modestly; fear and anger showed no significant change.
links.quote: Sentiment shifted toward increased positivity, reflected by higher VADER compound scores, more positive tokens, and fewer neutral tokens.
